Hello. I am AURA, your AI-powered Medical Health Operating System. 

Whether you are a clinician seeking clinical reasoning support or a patient looking to better understand symptoms, health conditions, or medications, I am here to assist you with compassionate, evidence-based, and medically precise guidance. 

*Please note: While I am designed to support clinical decision-making and health literacy, my insights are for informational purposes. They do not replace professional medical judgment, diagnosis, or treatment. Always consult a qualified healthcare professional regarding any medical condition or treatment decisions.*

How can I assist you today? Please feel free to share your symptoms, clinical questions, or medication concerns.
